content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) [E02] helps job-seekers and established craftspeople launch small businesses outside agriculture. It is a credit-linked subsidy scheme launched in 2008 that aims to generate employment opportunities by supporting the establishment of new micro-enterprises in both rural and urban areas, promoting self-employment among traditional artisans, unemployed youth, and other eligible beneficiaries in the non-farm sector [E02]. The scheme explicitly prohibits agricultural activities like cultivation of crops, plantation, sericulture, horticulture, and floriculture [E03], thereby focusing on non-agricultural enterprises.","cited_evidence_ids":["E02","E03"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy scheme launched in 2008 that supports establishment of micro-enterprises","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"PMEGP promotes self-employment among traditional artisans and unemployed youth in the non-farm sector","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"PMEGP prohibits agricultural activities and focuses on non-agricultural enterprises","evidence_ids":["E03"]}]}
